feeds.title: OzKilts Blog
feeds.description: OzKilts is the Australian Utility Kilt Company. Supplying quality hand-made utility kilts throughout Australia and beyond! Dedicated to bringing affordable, quality utility kilts and more. We're excited to share our passion for all things kilts and provide you with specials, anecdotes & news in our blog.

feeds.title: The Utility Kilt
feeds.description: We are offering a wide range of custom-made Utility Kilts with no compromise on quality. We offer the highest quality kilts to give your a modern look. We are a manufacturer of utility kilts, leather kilts, tartan kilts, and hybrid kilts. Be it a traditional, modern, or utility kilt, we specialize in creating customized kilts to suit everyone.

feeds.title: Skilt Blog
feeds.description: Modern kilts for the man of the world. Designed, built, and tested in the East End of London. No tight trouser tubes squeezing your legs or anything else. With a kilt you are free. Our kilts feature designer fabrics, reflective piping, hidden pleats, applique, and corozo buttons.

feeds.title: Scotland Kilt Collection Blog
feeds.description: Wearing a kilt is so much more than just the act of wearing it; it encompasses and shows off everything you love about your Scottish heritage in a way that is iconic and stylish. The Scotland Kilt Collection Blog is a mini journal about Kilts and contains all the latest information about kilt culture and life.

feeds.title: The Scotland Kilt Co Blog
feeds.description: We are a family-run Highlandwear company based in the heart of Edinburgh. We work alongside the top weavers in the country to offer a vast range of tartans. From the finest hand-stitched kilts, made-to-measure jackets, Scottish-made sporrans, Sgian-dubhs and belt buckles, we stock a huge selection of kilts.

feeds.title: Houston Kiltmakers Blog
feeds.description: Houston Kiltmakers is a fourth-generation family-run business with over 100 years of experience as gentlemen outfitters, Highland wear & Tartan Specialists. We do a massive range of tartans, having the capability of producing or designing any tartan to buy. We offer the best highland wear money can buy.

feeds.title: MacGregor and MacDuff Blog
feeds.description: We specialize in quality kilt sales, highland wear accessories, and kilt hire. Our staff is extremely dedicated, hardworking, and knowledgeable. We strive to be the supplier of choice for Kiltmaking, Kilt Sales, and Kilt Hire, by efficiently delivering customer value and service, which we believe, are the benchmark for our industry.

feeds.title: House of Labhran Blog
feeds.description: Our Labhran-style blog will bring you regular posts and articles with our thoughts and ideas for Scottish Gentlemen, Dandies and Rogues. Featuring our news and views on kilts, tweeds tartans and vintage antique Highland wear finds. Enjoy the posts and check back regularly for the latest posts. Share our passion for Scottish national dress.

feeds.title: Scottishkiltshop.com Blog
feeds.description: We at Scottish Kilt Shop, believe that Scots should take pride in their culture, and that means taking pride in their traditional Scottish dress by wearing premium kilts that reflect that history and honor it all the same. We return kilt-making to its original process by creating each one by hand using high-quality materials that you'll be proud to own. Explore the vibrant culture & captivating stories. Unveil the secrets of Scotland through our engaging blogs.

feeds.title: Kilts For Hire Blog
feeds.description: We are genuine Highlandwear and Tartan Specialists since 1909. Let us create the perfect look for your wedding by offering you the largest and best range of Highland wear in Scotland. We have the facility to match any name to a tartan with our Tartan directory and can offer a Tartan Swatch for most tartans to help coordinate with the bridal dress.

feeds.title: Gavin Kilt Maker Blog
feeds.description: We are a local family-run business since 1985. We provide the finest quality handmade Made to Measure Kilts and full Highland Outfit hire for weddings and all your special occasions. We now have a store in Fraserburgh and Peterhead providing this service to the whole of Aberdeenshire and further afield.

feeds.title: Fashion Kilt Blog
feeds.description: Embrace your Scottish heritage with all types of Kilts including Traditional Tartan Kilts & Utility Kilts. Our objective is to make you feel confident while wearing your Kilt. When you wear a Kilt or any other clothes which you have designed for yourself and when it fits you as per your desired measurement & fittings.

feeds.title: Damn Near Kilt 'Em Blog
feeds.description: The Damn Near Kilt 'Em blog is a community of kilters, kilt lovers, and utility kilt enthusiasts from around the world. You'll also find deals, new products, and offers from the best-damn-quality utility kilt company in the world, Damn Near Kilt 'Em. Free yourself from pants prison.

feeds.title: Gordon Nicolson Kiltmakers
feeds.description: Have the full GNK expert experience from the comfort of your own home. Expertly tailoring Scotland's iconic handmade kilts and creating highland wear outfits designed to last a lifetime. Handmade kilts tailored to exacting standards. Bespoke and hire outfits, created right in the heart of Edinburgh.

feeds.title: Kilt Zone Blog
feeds.description: We at kiltzone believe in quality and affordability and that's why our collection of kilts is handmade using the finest materials available out there. Now, you don't have to work overtime just to be able to buy a kilt. Our aim is to provide quality while keeping the price reasonable. Each kilt that we produce goes through different stages of testing to make sure that they meet the standards.

feeds.title: UKkilt Blog
feeds.description: UKkilt is an online e-commerce store that sells highland traditional and modern dresses. On this website, you will find kilts, jackets, and other accessories at a very good price. We mainly deal in Traditional and Modern Kilts and jackets for our Scottish-loving customers.
